title: Concept: Python requirement pinned across an epoch boundary
description: requirements.txt declares a pin that includes a PEP 440 epoch (`N!`), which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Epochs exist to override version ordering, so the pinned version can sort above later upstream releases and hide an upgrade the project needs.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: Epochs exist to override version ordering, so the pinned version can sort above later upstream releases and hide an upgrade the project needs.
